abilities.canonical_handler: FluentCrm\App\Http\Controllers\CustomContactFieldsController::saveGlobalFields
abilities.registrar_description_note: Registrar description names this 'CustomFieldsController::updateContactFields'; the actual installed-source controller is CustomContactFieldsController (path: app/Http/Controllers/CustomContactFieldsController.php). Description-only drift, not fixed in Package 1 — out of scope.
abilities.destructive_semantics: Full-replace: provided `fields` array overwrites the entire definition set; empty array clears all definitions globally. Handler-side guard requires `confirm_full_replace: true` when `fields` is empty.
abilities.notes: Fix landed in Package 1 of the v1.4.0 fix sprint. Phase 2 stop-condition event (2026-05-15): empty {fields: []} call wiped 8 production custom-field definitions on helenawillow before the V8 guard existed. The vendor controller (CustomContactFieldsController::saveGlobalFields) only reads `fields` from $this->request — the php://input transport-envelope leak that affects create-webhook does NOT apply here because the leak keys are not consumed by the saveGlobalFields handler. Live read-back verified on helenawillow 2026-05-15: empty-array call without `confirm_full_replace` returns typed WP_Error and the seeded testclient field remains intact; the same call with `confirm_full_replace: true` proceeds and clears the set.

abilities.canonical_handler: FluentCrm\App\Models\Webhook::store
abilities.notes: Fix landed in Package 1 of the v1.4.0 fix sprint. Registrar bypasses the REST controller and calls the vendor public model Webhook::store() directly (V3 priority 2 — same write path the controller uses internally). Reason: FluentCRM's Request::all() (vendor framework/src/WPFluent/Http/Request/Request.php inputs() at array_merge($this->request, $json)) re-reads php://input and merges over WP_REST_Request::set_param values, defeating any whitelist applied via rest_do_request. Routing through the model keeps the documented vendor operation while making the V7 input whitelist binding. V10: typed WP_Error returned when vendor class is absent. Live read-back verified on helenawillow 2026-05-15: persisted webhook value contains only {name, status, provider, url}; transport envelope (method/params/jsonrpc/id/toolUseId/_links/_embedded) does not appear.

abilities.canonical_handler: FluentCrm\App\Models\Webhook::saveChanges
abilities.notes: Package 3.5 (P-I family, ledger Addendum 1). update-webhook is the second confirmed (c) — same leak shape as create-webhook: WebhookController::update calls $webhook->saveChanges($request->all()) and Webhook::saveChanges() (app/Models/Webhook.php:88) array_merges the whole payload into the stored webhook `value`, excluding only id/url. The vendor Request::all() re-reads php://input so a rest_do_request whitelist cannot stop the MCP transport envelope from reaching saveChanges(). Fix: callback whitelists top-level input to schema-declared keys (name/lists/tags/companies/extra), looks up the webhook via the vendor public model, and calls saveChanges() with the cleaned payload (V3 priority 2 — bypasses the REST controller). V10: typed WP_Error when vendor class absent / id missing / webhook not found. LIVE READ-BACK: VERIFIED (2026-05-16, helenawillow, via mcp-adapter-execute-ability after abilities-mcp#87 Workstream B fix restored the direct-tool catalog): create-webhook (id 478) -> update-webhook called with the full MCP transport envelope injected (method/params/jsonrpc/toolUseId/_links/_embedded) plus a legitimate `name` change -> list-webhooks shows the persisted `value` = {name(updated),status,provider,url,tags:[],lists:[],companies:[]} — ONLY schema-declared keys; ZERO envelope keys reached saveChanges(). Webhook deleted; list-webhooks confirmed 0 residue. Unit-proven: tests/Unit/CRM/SafetyFixesTest.php asserts only schema keys reach saveChanges() and the proxy path is not used.
